name: Dragon Endurance (Crew-3)
about: Dragon Endurance (Crew-3) (2021-103A), a crewed vehicle (Dragon 2), launched 2021 Nov 11. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2021 Nov 11), held fixed
docked to A08583; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
